title: Current Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates current using I = Q/t to obtain 5 A.

title: Voltage Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates voltage using U = I R to obtain 20 V.

title: Ohm's Law Application
description: Important: Applies Ohm's law (U = IR) using the calculated current and given resistance.

title: Current Definition
description: Important: Recognizes that current is defined as charge per unit time.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Shows units throughout calculations or explicitly states final units.

title: Incorrect Current Formula
description: Pitfall: Uses I = t/Q or other incorrect formula for current calculation.

title: Ohm's Law Misapplication
description: Pitfall: Attempts to use Ohm's law without first calculating current, or uses incorrect variables.
